title: Electromagnetic force (তড়িৎ চৌম্বক বল)
placement: Book page 68, topic 3.2.2: তড়িৎ চৌম্বক বল বা বিদ্যুৎ চৌম্বকীয় বল (Electromagnetic Force), next to that paragraph.
description: The electromagnetic force (তড়িৎ চৌম্বক বল, page 68, 3.2.2) in two examples, on the clean panel (one action, one result, one rule). চিরুনি, the book's own experiment, in one table-top view: the student's head at the edge of the picture, the comb in the front of the hair, and bits of paper (1.7–2.1 cm) on the table under the face, all in view at every size. The one action, in two numbered steps whose badge also rings the thing to touch in 3D: ১ চিরুনি দিয়ে চুল আঁচড়াও (five strokes: blue − discs fill the comb, loose hairs stand up), then ২ চিরুনি কাগজের কাছে আনো (it comes down over the bits, they jump up and cling once its pull beats their weight, and it lifts them into the air). One bit carries two arrows, পুরো পৃথিবীর টান (down, purple, মাধ্যাকর্ষণ বল) and চিরুনির টান (up, blue, তড়িৎ চৌম্বক বল); the result line compares them (চিরুনির টান < / > পুরো পৃথিবীর টান) and the rule line says, in the book's words, that the comb's tiny charge beat the whole Earth's gravity, with 'বই বলছে 10^36 গুণ' kept apart from the comb. A comb with no charge lifts nothing (tap the paper first to see it). চুম্বক: a 1.5 V cell, a knife switch and a coil of copper wire in a row, and a bar magnet (N red, S grey) on a little cart: ১ সুইচ চালু করো (the current runs, the coil becomes a magnet and pulls the magnet in: unlike poles), ২ চুম্বকটি ঘুরিয়ে দাও (like poles: pushed to the end of its track); turned back, it is pulled in again from the far end (range infinite). A corner note says the coil's pull is drawn stronger than a real one. The rule grows into the book's: তড়িৎ বল ও চৌম্বক বল মিলে তড়িৎ চৌম্বক বল; মাধ্যাকর্ষণ বলের তুলনায় অনেক শক্তিশালী; পাল্লা অসীম. A quiet strip names the four fundamental forces in order (weakest → strongest), this one marked. Test: 5 tap questions, each set up in the picture (why the paper rises or what an uncombed comb does; like or unlike poles; the coil with the switch open; which force is stronger and by how much; whether the coil still pulls the magnet at the far end), each with a worked answer and a note on the mistake. Phone-first, Bangla. GLB: the comb scene (student, comb, bits of paper, table) and the magnet scene (cell, switch, coil, bar magnet on its cart), life size: modelled in mm, exported in metres (no arrows or labels).
